title: Probability of equivalent events
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $p$, and let $P,Q$ be predicates on $\Omega$ that hold for exactly the same elements. Then the probabilities of $P$ and $Q$ under $p$ are equal.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
For every $x\in\Omega$, $P(x)$ holds if and only if $Q(x)$ holds
